title: Add a shared response rule
summary: ASP.NET Core: Add a shared response rule. Inspect Cache-Control with curl -i.
introduction: Middleware can run before and after later handlers. GET /note carries the header set here.
learningObjectives: Add a shared response rule with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Add a shared response rule

blocks.text: The middleware adds Cache-Control, then awaits the next handler. That handler supplies the note.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Call next when the request should continue through the pipeline.
